data.narrative:
Speedata is a Series B semiconductor company that has raised $114M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 5 private-sector comparables in chips and semiconductors at same or adjacent funding stages, supplemented by 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) for sector context. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied here due to absence of revenue disclosure typical for private companies.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $114M total raised as a proxy valuation base and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies $217M. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector comparables—SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series A), Etched ($5.0B, Series C), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series C), Positron AI ($1.0B, Series B), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M to $11.0B. The dispersion reflects stage and business-model heterogeneity within frontier chip ventures.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $184M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around revenue traction, intellectual property defensibility, and customer validation typical at Series B in capital-intensive semiconductor development. Stage-progression yields the conservative floor; peer-median dominates the range and reflects current market pricing for comparable-stage chip ventures.
